title: [Master]-User is unable to filter the Deferral Summary-GL Report Not Filtering Totals by Global Dimensions.
summary: The Deferral Summary - G/L report now correctly filters and displays totals when using global dimensions, resolving filtering issues in the report.
key_points: Fixed report filtering to work properly with global dimensions
Report totals now filter correctly based on applied dimension filters
Added test coverage across multiple localization layers to validate the fix
Changes ensure users can filter the report by global dimensions as expected
